errorCodes.meaning: No board the caller facilitates has this identifier, and the caller may not see it (VTI-BRD-003).
No active member has this entry.
The member already facilitates the board — by an appointment to it, or by holding vtc.boards.manage unqualified.

BoardId.description: Opaque identifier of a board: `brd_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-BRD-001).
BoardId.title: BoardId

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/boards/facilitators/add/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/boards/facilitators/add/0.1#response. The board's appointed facilitators after the appointment.

facilitators.description: The board's appointed facilitators after the change, by entry: entries holding `vtc.boards.manage` qualified to this board, read from the access-control list. Holders of the capability unqualified or through a role are not listed (VTI-BRD-093).

Response.title: VTC Boards — Facilitators — Add — response payload
